title: IVG Original Salts Forest Berries Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Forest Berries Ice 10ml E-Liquid delivers a deep, layered fruit profile perfect for those who appreciate complexity. This blend brings together dark Blackberries and rich Blackcurrants, layered with the sharp brightness of Red Currants and a sweet, juicy burst of Red Cherries. To round off the intensity, a cool, icy finish provides a brisk contrast, ensuring each puff is both deep and refreshing. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the deep forest fruits of Forest Berries Ice, vapers can explore other stellar options like the vibrant Blue Blaze or the tangy Sour Green Apple. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
